First part: theft (盗窃). The description: 彭某某 and 张某某 conspired to pickpocket iPhone, then sold. So theft (盗窃). Also possibly "抢劫"? No, it's pickpocket, so theft.

Second part: drug trafficking (贩卖毒品). He sold heroin 0.84g. So crime: 贩卖毒品.

Also there is mention that 彭某某 helped police capture drug dealer, but that's a mitigating factor, not a crime.

Thus two crimes: 盗窃;贩卖毒品.

Thus answer format: [罪名]盗窃;贩卖毒品<eoa>
